observations: Photo 1 shows a white upright chest/deep freezer with a visible brand label on the front door reading “HISENSE THERMCOOL” (logo text visible).
Photo 0 shows the lid open; the inner lid panel has circular molded sections and a central drain/plug area; the inner base shows heavy frost/ice and wet-looking surfaces.
Photo 2 shows the back/side with a black wire condenser/grille area; the freezer exterior looks generally intact but there are visible scuffs/marks around the base area.

claims.claim: “Classic and reliable themocool freezer with a string capacity long lasting freezing for up to five...”
claims.evidence: Seller text is not fully readable in photos; freezer capacity (liters) and the “up to five” duration are not shown.
Photos show frost/ice and wear marks; no date/usage meter/serial age is visible.

claims.claim: “No fault at all, the motor was never opened.”
claims.evidence: No proof of motor condition; photos do not show internal motor access or testing.
No receipt/warranty card is shown in the provided photos.

risks.risk: Freezer may not be cooling properly (heavy frost/ice and wet-looking interior can indicate poor temperature control or it being defrosted/left open).
risks.proof: A short video of the freezer running after plugging in (showing thermostat setting) plus a thermometer reading inside after 30–60 minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working (worst case: treat as needs service/possible weak cooling).

risks.risk: Capacity/size mismatch (seller mentions “string capacity” but liters are not visible; price depends heavily on size).
risks.proof: Photo of the rating/label plate showing model and capacity (liters) and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end comparable for deep freezers in Rivers.

risks.risk: Warranty/receipt may not be transferable or may not exist (seller claims availability).
risks.proof: Clear photos of the receipt and warranty card with matching serial/model to the freezer label.

risks.risk: Exterior damage/poor sealing (scuffs and base marks; lid seal condition not shown).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the door gasket/seal around the full perimeter and a test for air leaks (paper strip test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible seal wear (reduced cooling efficiency).

proof_requests: Photo of the freezer’s rating/serial label showing model and capacity (liters).
Video showing it plugged in and running, plus an internal temperature reading after 30–60 minutes.
Clear photos of the receipt and warranty card, with serial/model matching the freezer label.
Close-up of the door gasket/seal and a paper-strip air-leak test around the lid.
response.reason: The brand is readable (HISENSE THERMCOOL), but key pricing drivers—capacity and confirmed working/freezing performance—are not proven. The interior frost/wet appearance increases the risk that it may not be cooling correctly, so a worst-case price without proof would be unreliable.
